text: Appeal of Order to Comply (January 5, 2018) for 70 Spadina Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated January 5, 2018, for the property located at 70 Spadina Road, Folder No. 17 276850 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 30, 2018. 2. Amended Item 4 as listed in Schedule "A", in the Order to Comply, dated January 5, 2018, to replace the word "North" with the word "East". 3. Amended Item 5 as listed in Schedule "A", in the Order to Comply, dated January 5, 2018, to replace the word "North" with the word "East".
